findings.title_en: Work inside a confined space without verifiable entry controls
Respiratory protection inside the tank cannot be verified
Safety harness retrieval connection cannot be verified

summary_en: Three findings were recorded: 2 medium and 1 low, with no confirmed high finding from the frames. The most urgent is work inside the closed metallic tank without verifiable permit, ventilation, attendant and rescue controls. Entry to the tank should remain suspended until on-site verification of all controls, respiratory protection and the retrieval system.
